items.summary: On this episode of Stock Movers: - Advanced Micro Devices (AMD) shares are falling after Hunterbrook Capital said it shorted the stock, following a report by its media affiliate that the chipmaker is reliant on a potentially risky business in China. - Ross Stores (ROST) shares are tumbling after the company gave weaker-than-expected guidance for the fourth quarter due to higher costs. - Intuit (INTU) is the biggest decliner in the premarket after the software maker cut its full-year revenue forecast, driven by weak performance in Credit Karma, a personal finance platform that’s under increasing threat from agentic AI tools. (Source: Bloomberg)

items.title: Review: WATCH: Reporter goes undercover as porch pirate
items.summary: A New York Times reporter went undercover as a porch pirate to help identify the best ways to keep your home and packages safe as package deliveries ramp up this holiday season.

items.title: Review: J.P. Morgan’s Gatch on Where Active ETFs Go Next
items.summary: J.P. Morgan Asset Management CEO George Gatch joins Bloomberg's Katie Greifeld and Eric Balchunas for a special edition of ETF IQ live on stage at the Bloomberg ETFs in Depth Conference in New York on November 26, 2026. Gatch discusses the opportunity for active ETFs, particularly in fixed income, and the limits of putting illiquid assets into ETF structures. He also looks at growing institutional adoption and the expansion of ETFs in markets outside the US. (Source: Bloomberg)
